questions.question: The sum of the lengths of the edges of a cube is equal to half the perimeter of a square. If the numerical value of the volume of the cube is equal to one-sixth of the numerical value of the area of the square, then the length of one side of the square is:
questions.solution:
Let ‘a’ units be the side of the square.

So, perimeter of the square = 4a

Sum of the lengths of the edges of a cube = 12 × length of one edge of a cube

⇒ 12 × length of one edge of a cube = 1/2 × 4a = 2a

⇒ length of one edge of a cube = 2a/12 = a/6

Given, volume of the cube = one-sixth of the area of the square

⇒ (a/6)³ = 1/6 × a²

⇒ a³/216 = a²/6

⇒ a = 36 units

∴ The length of one side of the square is 36 units

questions.question: When iron is exposed to moist air, a reddish brown coating of hydrated Iron (III) Oxide (Fe₂O₃) is deposited on its surface. This reddish-brown coating is called ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** rust.**

__**CONCEPT:**__

__
 
• **Corrosion** is the process by which a metal reacts with moisture, air and other substances.
 
• **Rusting of iron** is an example of corrosion.

**EXPLANATION:**__

 
• Rust is an iron oxide, which occurs when iron or an alloy that contains iron, like steel, is exposed to oxygen and moisture for a long period of time.
 
• When iron is exposed to moist air, a reddish-brown coating of **hydrated Iron (III) Oxide (Fe2O3)** is deposited on its surface. This reddish-brown coating is called** rust.**

**Note**: The chemical equation for the formation of rust is:

Iron + Water + Oxygen = Rust.

i.e.** 4 Fe(s) + 7 H₂O(l) + O₂(g) → 2 Fe₂O₃..3/2 H₂O(s) + 8H⁺(aq)**

Therefore, the chemical formula for rust is** Fe₂O₃.nH₂O.**

 
• The rusting of iron can be prevented by painting, oiling, greasing, galvanizing.

questions.question: Two pipes X and Y can individually fill a tank in 48 and 72 minutes respectively. If they are opened simultaneously, how long would it take for the tank to fill?
questions.solution:
Two pipes X and Y can individually fill a tank in 48 and 72 minutes respectively.

Part of tank filled by X and Y together in 1 hour = 1/48 + 1/72 = (3 + 2)/144 = 5/144

∴ Time taken by both the pipes to fill the tank = 144/5 = 28.8 minutes

questions.question: A train crosses a 550 m long platform in 36 seconds. How long was the train if it was travelling at the speed of 70 km/h?
questions.solution:
Let length of the train = l meters

Given, speed of the train = 70 km/h = 70 × 5/18 m/s

Since, it crosses a 550 m long platform = 36 s

⇒ (550 + l)/(70 × 5/18) = 36

⇒ 550 + l = 36 × 70 × 5/18 = 700

⇒ l = 150 m

∴ The length of the train = 150 m

questions.question: Pramod can paint a wall red in 12 hours while Brajen can paint the wall red completely in 16 hours. If Pramod and Brajen work alternately for an hour each stalling when the wall has just cement on it till when it is completely painted red, how many hours will it take to paint the entire wall red?
questions.solution:
Pramod can paint a wall red in 12 hours while Brajen can paint the wall red completely in 16 hours

So, total work (LCM of 12 and 16) = 48 units

Pramod can paint the wall in 1 hour = 48/12 = 4 unit

Brajen can paint the wall in 1 hour = 48/16 = 3 unit

If Pramod and Brajen work alternately for an hour

So, work done in 2 hours = 7 units

Work done in 12 hours = 7 × 6 = 42 units

Now, Work done by Pramod in next 1 hour = 42 + 4 = 46 units

Remaining work = 48 - 46 = 2 units

Now, 3 units’ work done by Brajen = 1 hours

Thus, 2 units’ work done by Brajen = 1/3 × 2 hours = 2/3 hours = 2/3 × 60 = 40 min

∴ Total time = 12 + 1 + 2/3 = 13 hours 40 minutes

questions.question: According to Ohm's Law, which of the following is true?

options.text: The current flowing through a wire is inversely proportional to its length
The current flowing through a wire is directly proportional to its Resistance.
The current flowing through a wire is directly proportional to the Potential Difference applied across its ends.
The current flowing through the wire is inversely proportional to the Potential Difference applied across its ends.

questions.solution:
**__CONCEPT__:**

**Ohm's Law:**

__
 
• The **current flowing through a wire** is **directly proportional to the potential difference applied across its ends**, provided the **physical conditions such as temperature remains unchanged**.

i.e. V = IR

 Where V = potential difference, R = resistance and I = current.

**EXPLANATION__:**

 
• Ohm's law states that the **current through** a conductor between two points is **directly proportional to the voltage** **across the two points**, given that the **physical conditions** such as **length or temperature** **of wire remain constant**. Therefore option 1 is incorrect.
 
• The **current flowing through a wire** is **inversely proportional to its resistance **i.e., **more the resistance** **less will be the current** and vice - versa. Therefore option 2 is incorrect.
 
• From above it is clear that the **Ohm's law states** that **current flowing through a wire** is **directly proportional **to the **potential difference applied across its ends**. Therefore option 3 is correct and option 4 is incorrect.

questions.question: A body has a weight W on the surface of Earth. What is its weight on a planet whose mass is 15 times that of Earth and a radius that is 4 times that of the earth?
questions.solution:
On Earth, G is Gravitational constant, Mass of the Earth = M and Radius = r.

⇒ W = GMm/r²

On Other Planet, Mass = 15 M, Radius = 4r 

∴ W₁ = G × 15Mm/16r² 

W₁ = GMm/r² × 15/16 

⇒ W₁= W × 15/16

∴ Weight of the body on the Planet will be 15/16 of the Weight on Earth.

questions.question: What is the least number consisting of five digits that is exactly divisible by 12, 18, 20 and 25?
questions.solution:
12 = 2 × 2 × 3

18 = 2 × 3 × 3

20 = 2 × 2 × 5

25 = 5 × 5

LCM of 12, 18, 20 and 25 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 5 = 900

Smallest number consisting of five digits = 10000

Now, when we divide 10000 by 900. So, we get remainder = 100

∴ (10000 + (900 - 100)) = 10800 is the least 5-digit number which is exactly divisible by 900

questions.question: The length of one side of a rhombus is 17 cm and one of the diagonals was 16 cm. Find the length of the other diagonal.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a rhombus, diagonals bisect each other at right angles (90°).

Given: Side = 17 cm and Half of diagonal 1 = 16 ÷ 2 = 8 cm.

Using Pythagorean triplet (8, 15, 17), half of other diagonal = 15 cm.

Total length of other diagonal = 15 × 2 = 30 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side of rhombus (a) = 17 cm

One diagonal (d₁) = 16 cm

**Formula Used:**

In a rhombus, the relationship between side (a) and diagonals (d₁, d₂) is: 4a² = d₁² + d₂²

 

 
• 
 
• 
 
 Side = 17 cm
 8 cm
 x
 Rhombus Diagonals Property

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4 × (17)² = (16)² + d₂²

⇒ 4 × 289 = 256 + d₂²

⇒ 1156 = 256 + d₂²

⇒ d₂² = 1156 − 256

⇒ d₂² = 900

⇒ d₂ = √900

⇒ d₂ = 30 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 30 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Rhombus

The area can be calculated using diagonals: Area = 1/2 × d₁ × d₂.

Perimeter of Rhombus

Since all sides are equal, Perimeter = 4 × side.

Diagonal Bisector Property

In any rhombus, the diagonals bisect each other at right angles (90°), forming four congruent right-angled triangles.

Common Pythagorean Triplets

Useful triplets for such problems include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (8, 15, 17), and (7, 24, 25).</p

questions.question: The radius of curvature of a concave mirror is 30 cm. Following Cartesian Sign Convention, its focal length is expressed as ________.
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__**:**

Concave mirror: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd46dbb5e79742fc7645b2e2862a063ca72241c162d59aaa7bc9902c0e447fec.png] 

__
 
• If the **inner surface of the spherical mirror** is the reflecting surface, then it is called a **concave mirror**. It is also called a focusing mirror/converging mirror.
 
• 
 
 
• The size of the image produced by these mirrors can be larger or smaller than the object, depending upon the distance of the object from the mirror.
 
• The concave mirror can form both real as well as virtual images of any object.
 
 

**Sign convention in mirrors**

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

(I) Bleaching powder is a pale yellow powder.

(IV) The pH of acid rain is nearly 5.6.

options.text: All of the above statements are correct

questions.solution:
• Litmus is an acid-base indicator for aqueous solution
 
• The un-ionized litmus is red, whereas the ion is blue in colour. When there is sufficient OH- ions in the medium, the weak acid is converted to its salt, so blue colour predominates.
 
• In acidic solutions, however, the non-ionic form predominates, hence the red colour. 
 
• Ammonia is basic in nature.
 
• Dry ammonia produces no hydroxide OH- ions. So there is no action on litmus paper.
 
• Besides a solution of ammonia in water releases OH- ions. Therefore, the litmus paper turns Red litmus to blue.

questions.question: Five angles of a hexagon measure 116° each. What is the measure of the remaining angle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Five angles of a hexagon measure 116° each.

**Formula used:**

Total angle of any regular polygon = (n - 2)× 180

**Calculation:**

Sum of internal angles in a hexagon(n = 6)

⇒ (6 - 2)× 180

⇒ 720o

According to the question,

Five angles is 116° × 5 = 580°

Remaining angle = 720° - 580°

⇒ 140° 

**∴ The measure of the remaining angle is 140o**.

questions.question: If the momentum of a body is tripled keeping the mass as constant, its Kinetic Energy will ________.

options.text: become nine times its original value
become six times its original value
become three times its original value

questions.solution:
__**CONCEPT**__:

__
 
• Kinetic energy: The **energy of an object due to its motion** is called kinetic energy.

 
 
• It is denoted by **KE**.
 
• Mathematically **kinetic energy** can be written as 
 
• Kinetic energy (KE) = 1/2 mv2
 
 
 
• **Momentum**: The **product of mass and velocity** is called **momentum **or **linear momentum**.
 
 
• It is denoted by **P**.
 
• Mathematically it can be written as 
 
• Momentum (P) = m × v
 
 
 
• The** relationship between kinetic energy and momentum** is given by:

KE=(P²)/(2m)​

Where m is mass of the object and v is the velocity

**CALCULATION**__**:**

Given - Final momentum (P₂) = 3P (initial momentum)

 
• The relationship between kinetic energy and momentum is given by:

KE=(P²)/(2m)​

 
• When the **momentum of an object is tripled keeping the mass as constant:**

**​Rightarrow {KE}₂=(P²₁)/(2m)**

Rightarrow {KE}₂=((3P)²)/(2m)=(9P²)/(2m) = 9(KE) [because KE=(P²)/(2m)]

 
• Hence, **if the momentum of a body is tripled, it's Kinetic energy will become nine times its original value**. So option 2 is correct.

questions.question: A right-angled triangle ABC is right-angled at B, and tan A = 4/3. If AC = 25 cm, the length of BC is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cbac162bca60e4a3cfcd6ea3d491171c7cddb5ac2eafcbcc1e86ff2212615f5.png] 

Given, tan A = 4/3 = BC/AB

Let BC = 4x and AB = 3x

By Pythagoras theorem,

AC² = AB² + BC²

⇒ 25² = (3x)² + (4x)²

⇒ 625 = 9x² + 16x²

⇒ 625 = 25x²

⇒ x² = 25

⇒ x = 5

∴ length of BC = 4x = 4 × 5 = 20 cm
